about_the_game:
After a US Navy Ship disappears somewhere of the coast of East Australia while unmarked ships have been spotted for months in that area, special US military personal have been tasked to find any signs of said Navy Ship while keeping a look out for the unmarked ships.

While searching, an area right in the middle between East Australia and Mexico is discovered to have constant storms and a thick fog and might have caused the Navy Ship to disappear.

After a few days of preparing, you and your soldiers fly into the fog on military helicopters for a scouting operation when something beneath the waves start taking down the helicopters one by one.

Crashed onto the the island that only brings death and despair, you will have to survive by exploring the many wreckage's at the coastline, setup small camps and try to find any survivors while waiting for possible rescue.

All of this will lead to the reality that you weren't looking for a US Navy Ship to be exact....

This Single Player Hardcore Survival and Shooter game will launch in early-access, starting with an introduction level, 

2 possible base location levels you can choose to build your camp at and 2 maps to enter and then survive, fight, gather resources in and progress the story.

Map names:

  • Coastal Crashsite

  • The wreckage

*Game will launch in early access(end 2026) to find any new bugs and gather feedback, but will launch in a complete, playable state.

The game will also be released with a gore-censor option for youtube(to prevent demonetization).

Holum Island, Island of Unspeakable Horrors, the Structureworld...... for centuries, stories have been told about an island in the mist. An island of death and despair, only be found by people stuck in the massive storms that threaten this part of the sea.

But there is one name everybody knows: Skull Island.

Jump into this Single Player Hardcore Survival and Shooter game that lets you explore a new interpretation of Skull Island like you have never seen before!

With building mechanics that let you set traps, build small shelters, gather food and resources, this survival game gives you the freedom to explore and settle on the Coastal Area of Skull Island filled with prehistoric wild life but evolved, dinosaurs and fantasy creatures based on the location of the island.

The game heavily focusses on a semi-open world filled with creatures from big to really small to make it feel more alive.

Each creature has his own place in the ecosystem, with AI focussed on this aspect.

It is possible to overhunt animals(for a short time) because of the spawning system and animals will react to your way of hunting.

The game also features a dynamic weather system that will not only impact the spawnrates of certain animals, but will also result in respawning of resources given to you by the sea.

Sometimes it is better to start running instead of fighting the many hostile animals on the island.

They will crawl from caves, fall from the basalt cliffs, attack you from above and... from carcasses?

content_descriptors.notes:
Fictional Mushrooms to heal/fix certain stats for the player.

Dead carcasses of (fictional) (sea) creatures but can be toggled off to prevent demonetization on Youtube!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-6700 CPU @ 3.40GHz 3.41 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Just like Minecraft, Java & OpenGL is needed to run

short_description: Survive in this epic semi-open world Survival/Shooter Game on a new interpretation of Skull Island filled with your biggest nightmares! Start building your Base of Operations in one of the two buidable area's, enter different biomes of the island to scout, gather resources and find a way to escape!
